## 简体中文

### 修复

- 在执行窗口激活或最小化前先结束应用图标的按压反馈。
- 多窗口应用点击仅提供视觉反馈；只有应用恰好包含一个窗口时，才根据当前状态执行恢复、最小化或聚焦。
- 延长跨应用预览面板移动与缩放动画，让加速和减速过程更易感知。

## English

### Fixed

- Released app icon press feedback before performing window activation or minimization work.
- Kept multi-window app clicks visual-only while restoring, minimizing, or focusing an app with exactly one window according to its current state.
- Lengthened cross-app preview panel movement and resizing to make the acceleration and deceleration easier to perceive.
